title: MyServiceNSW Account – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for using the MyServiceNSW Account, an online service operated by Service NSW.
intro:
### 1. How MyServiceNSW Account works

MyServiceNSW Account is an online service operated by Service NSW, on behalf of the NSW Government. We'll refer to Service NSW as 'we' or 'us' in these terms and conditions.

Once you have created your MyServiceNSW Account, you can use it to let NSW Government agencies (Partner Agencies) know who you are and access their online services.

A Partner Agency is a government organisation, or part of a government organisation, that provides online services to you, when you 'add' their services to your MyServiceNSW Account.

### 2. Importance of these terms and conditions

By creating a MyServiceNSW Account, you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions and have read the MyServiceNSW Account – Privacy Collection Notice.

Importantly, this means making sure you know and follow your responsibilities.

### 3. Updates to terms and conditions

Service NSW may change, add or remove any functionality of MyServiceNSW Account, or make changes to these terms and conditions at any time. If those changes affect your rights or responsibilities, Service NSW will notify you.

By logging in or staying logged in after that notification is sent, you accept the new terms and conditions.

These terms and conditions supersede and replace any terms and conditions that may have governed your use of the MyServiceNSW Account.

### 5. Privacy and security

By having a MyServiceNSW Account, you agree to Service NSW’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal information as set out in the MyServiceNSW Account – Privacy Collection Notice.

When you access an online service or transaction (operated by a Partner Agency or Service NSW), a separate privacy collection notice relating to that transaction may be provided. Any transaction privacy collection notice is in addition to the MyServiceNSW Account – Privacy Collection Notice.

Your account is for you only and you are not allowed to access another person's account.

### 7. Deactivating or deleting your account

When you deactivate your MyServiceNSW Account, you will not be able to use your account to log in to the Service NSW app or NSW Government websites. You will not be able to access and maintain services online. For example, you will not be able to access your Digital Driver Licence or Business Profile through your deactivated MyServiceNSW Account.

You can choose to deactivate your MyServiceNSW Account under ‘Manage account’, ‘Settings’ and 'Deactivate account' page within your account.

Additionally, Service NSW may deactivate your MyServiceNSW Account if it identifies security issues, banned uses or other matters as described in clause 8 to 13 of these Terms and Conditions.

When your MyServiceNSW Account is deactivated Service NSW is required, under the State Records Act 1998, to retain it until all associated records have passed their retention period. These records are evidence of products and/or services you may have accessed by using your account.

Any personal information stored independently by Partner Agencies or individual services may continue to be stored after account deactivation. Refer to the terms and conditions and privacy collection notices for those services and their associated Partner Agencies.

### Reactivating your account

There is only one way to reactivate your MyServiceNSW Account . You can reactivate your account by calling us on 13 77 88. Once you reactivate, you’ll need to add your services again.

Service NSW may reactivate a MyServiceNSW Account it has previously deactivated, once it is assured against any security issues, banned uses or other matters as described in clauses 8 to 13 of these Terms and Conditions.

### Deleting your account

MyServiceNSW Accounts can only be deleted after they have been deactivated for a minimum of 30 days.

You can request to delete your deactivated MyServiceNSW Account by calling us on 13 77 88. At this point Service NSW will mark the account for deletion, but it can only be deleted once all its associated records have passed their required retention period. Once an account has been marked for deletion it cannot be reactivated.

As part of account lifecycle management, Service NSW may delete unused deactivated MyServiceNSW Accounts without underlying transaction data in keeping with obligations under the Privacy and Personal Information Act 1998 and State Records Act 1998.

Any active services connected to your account, including Business Profile, will be delinked when you delete your MyServiceNSW Account.

faqs.q: What happens if Service NSW changes the terms and conditions?
faqs.a: Service NSW may change, add, or remove functionality or make changes to these terms at any time. If changes affect your rights or responsibilities, Service NSW will notify you, and by logging in or staying logged in, you accept the new terms.

faqs.q: What are my responsibilities when using the account?
faqs.a: You must not participate in illegal or fraudulent activity, cause disruption, harass others, or post unlawful, defamatory, offensive, or scandalous material.
